summary: Full frontend E2E of new live DP Merch storefront wiring against the real Stripe-based merch backend (https://trusted-connect-20.preview.emergentagent.com). All 4 backend endpoints verified via curl, all 8 UI flows verified via Playwright on mobile viewport. Every acceptance criterion in the review request passed. The expected 503 on POST /api/merch/checkout-sessions is rendered cleanly as the branded 'Checkout is temporarily unavailable — please check back soon.' notice with no crash and no fake success URL.

backend_verification.GET /api/merch/products: 200 — 5 products returned with ids dp-fancy-hoodie, dp-king-hoodie, dp-roadman-hoodie, dp-business-hoodie, dp-gym-hoodie
backend_verification.POST /api/merch/checkout-sessions (valid: 503 with detail 'Merchandise checkout is not configured yet - please try again later.' — EXPECTED per task

ui_flow_results.MERCH button opens store: PASS — top-left pink MERCH button navigates to merch-screen
ui_flow_results.Live catalogue (5 hoodies at £85): PASS — spinner then 5 product cards, price £85 fetched from backend
ui_flow_results.Product detail (Roadman) with 4 view tab: PASS — front/back/left/right tabs all present and switch image
ui_flow_results.Size pick triggers live quote: PASS — merch-quote-subtotal=£85, merch-quote-shipping=£4.99 (UK Standard Shipping), merch-quote-total=£89.99
ui_flow_results.Email validation (empty/invalid) blocks: PASS — notice 'Enter a valid email to continue.' shown; checkout API not called
ui_flow_results.Valid email + 503 handled cleanly: PASS — notice 'Checkout is temporarily unavailable — please check back soon.' shown; no stack trace; no fake URL
ui_flow_results.Size change re-fetches fresh quote: PASS — changing L→M triggered a new /quotes POST (verified via reqSeq logic + UI update)
ui_flow_results.Back navigation store→menu: PASS — merch-product-back returns to merch-screen; merch-back returns to main menu
ui_flow_results.Main menu regression: PASS visually — Main Menu with DRUNK PIGEONS, PLAY, PIGEONS, LEADERBOARD (via CODE/LEGAL), Drunkness slider, manor tiles incl. Easy Mode £14.99 (locked) all rendered correctly

critical_code_review_comments: Missing data-testid on MainMenu primary buttons: PLAY, PIGEONS, LEADERBOARD, and the MERCH button itself. Query by data-testid returned 0; had to fall back to text. Recommend adding main-menu-play / main-menu-pigeons / main-menu-leaderboard / main-menu-merch for future regression testability.
checkoutClient.reason classification: verified 'unavailable' path fires on 503 exactly as intended. No change needed.
Quote staleness handling in MerchProductScreen (isQuoteExpired + refresh on BUY) is defensively good — no issue.
Minor: on very small viewports the BUY NOW button initially sits below the fold; user must scroll. Acceptable for a ScrollView layout but worth an anchor/sticky consideration.
action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Add data-testid attributes on MainMenu buttons (main-menu-play, main-menu-pigeons, main-menu-leaderboard, main-menu-merch) to strengthen automated regression coverage.
test_credentials: None required — merch endpoints are unauthenticated in this environment.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Merch wiring is fully green. The 503 on /api/merch/checkout-sessions is the correct steady-state until Stripe key is server-configured; when that changes, re-run the BUY NOW flow and assert the returned checkoutUrl opens via Linking (currently Linking.openURL is called only when res.ok && res.checkoutUrl). Game backend (chip-pigeon) was NOT retested this pass — see iteration_44 and earlier.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in this iteration.
